d: Al Jomaih Energy & Water (AEW) headquartered in Saudi Arabia, is a fast-growing investor, lead developer, and operator of utility and infrastructure projects in various geographical markets such as KSA, GCC, Asia & North Africa, with investments in 6 GW of Conventional and Solar power plants, and around 700,000 m3/day of water.

AEW was established in 2007, as a subsidiary of Al Jomaih Holding Company, a leading Saudi conglomerate with a legacy spanning over 80 years, focused on enabling sustainable, social, and economic progress in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and beyond.

At AEW, our mission is to tackle new technologies, solve complex problems, and leverage our expertise to unlock opportunities in the Power, Renewables & Water Sectors, while driving impact for our stakeholders across the value chain.

This is a greenfield CCGT project to be constructed with a net power capacity of 2400 MW, together with its ancillary equipment, associated infrastructure and facilities. The Project comprises the Plant and associated Electrical Special Facilities (ESF). The Plant will be located inland at a site situated approximately 50 km north-east of the City of Abu Dhabi.

This role offers a unique opportunity to engage in the full lifecycle of the project, from design and engineering to construction and operation, all within a dynamic and innovative environment. This project promises stability and long-term impact.
Location: Taweelah, Abu Dhabi, UAE (Site is approx 30 to 40 Kms from Abu Dhabi city)

This role will serve as an Owner’s Representative for a Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CCGT) Independent Power Project, overseeing all civil engineering aspects of the project. This role involves technical reviews, quality assurance, and site inspections to ensure compliance with international standards, project specifications, and industry best practices.

The successful candidate will play a critical role in safeguarding the owner’s interests by monitoring project progress, ensuring adherence to quality and safety standards, and supporting the commissioning and operational phases of the plant. This position requires expertise in CCGT technology, a strong understanding of civil codes and standards, and the ability to manage related work in a high-performance environment.
q: Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or a related field.
Minimum of 5-7 years of relevant experience as Civil Engineer in Power Projects (Combined Cycle).
Professional Engineer (PE) license is highly desirable.
Hands-on experience with inspection techniques, construction practices, and structural integrity assessments for civil engineering projects.
Experienced in adhering to industry standards and codes such as ACI, ASTM, BS, ISO, and SBC, with a strong focus on concrete structures, steel works, soil mechanics, and foundation design.
Proficiency in testing and inspection techniques, including soil compaction testing, concrete strength testing, and rebar inspection, with expertise in interpreting test results, is highly desirable.
